admission.justification: Named current controls retain delivered-answer tokens on one workspace event and reject computed token fields in the projection. No removed ambient implementation or lifecycle-fold test is counted as a current witness.

applicability: The single-event tokens writer and every projection fold: events keep their tokens and no fold sums them.
conditions: The workspace tool-event writer records delivered_tokens as a per-event answer fact; no ambient session writer or aggregate counter is retained.
exclusions: Computed aggregates over events, which no longer exist.
statement: The tokens of a single event stay as a fact of its event; a row of the Event River may show them as the size of that one answer.
